# Production brief: Flat to Fixed in Fifteen

## Tempo map

Constant 130 bpm, 4/4, twelve bars in total (about 22 seconds), leaving roughly 8 seconds of bed for a spoken address after the final chorus. One-beat pickup on hand claps before bar 1; no count-in audible in the spot.

## Vocal treatment

Single bright lead with a short room reverb (0.4 s) in the first chorus and verse; the final chorus adds a four-voice group vocal panned wide. Light compression at 3:1 with a fast attack so every consonant of the brand name and tagline is clear. No pitch effects.

## Mix priorities

1. Brand name and tagline intelligibility above everything else.
2. Hand claps and snare forward so the tempo reads on a small radio speaker.
3. Keep the low end tight: high-pass the guitar at 120 Hz, bass sits under 200 Hz.
4. Leave the bed under the spoken address at about minus 12 dB from the chorus level.

## Section notes

- Chorus: full band in from beat one, claps on 2 and 4, lead vocal alone.
- Verse 1: electric guitar drops out, glockenspiel doubles the melody an octave up.
- Final Chorus: guitar back in, tambourine on eighths, group vocal on all four lines, a bicycle bell sample on the final downbeat.
